name: reviewer-research decide(approved) → coordinator wake-up
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign MVP-2 research pack terminal handler. Fires when reviewer-research terminates with decide(action=approved) — the research category's chain terminal. Spawns a fresh coordinator loop with the terminal reviewer's loop_id in related_loops so the coordinator can read_loop_result and synthesize a user-facing reply via decide(action=respond_direct). The respond_direct rule (configs/rules/coordinator/03b-respond-direct.json) then publishes the reply prose on the user-response bus.

Mirrors configs/rules/coordinator/04a-research-terminal-to-coordinator.json (the legacy chain.mode-keyed version) but scoped to the research pack only. Both rules co-exist during MVP-2 through MVP-6; the legacy 04a retires alongside chain.mode in MVP-7.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
The research chain you dispatched has reached its terminal. Reviewer-research at loop $entity.instance evaluated the research artifact and approved it.

Your job now is to deliver the answer to the user. You are not classifying or delegating — the chain has already done the work.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance) to read the reviewer's structured verdict. The reviewer's `reason` field summarises why the artifact was approved. If the reviewer's loop entity carries research.artifact.path or lineage.researcher, the structured artifact itself lives in the graph upstream — you may bash cat the path if read_loop_result's prose is too terse for a user-facing reply.

Iteration 2 — call decide(action="respond_direct", reason="<your synthesised user-facing answer drawn from the reviewer's verdict + the research artifact>"). The respond_direct rule (03b) publishes your `reason` on the user-response bus.

Write the `reason` field as plain prose addressing the user directly. Do not embed channel-specific markup (markdown links, buttons); channel routers add affordances downstream. Aim for a complete answer in 2-6 sentences — concise but standalone, since the user does not see the research artifact itself.

metadata.supersedes_legacy: configs/rules/coordinator/04a-research-terminal-to-coordinator.json — same wake-up shape, scoped to research pack only.
